 Vietnam Morning Monitor: Miss Universe Vietnam stripped of crown over contract dispute, Hanoi pilots electric tricycles for garbage collection 
 Miss Universe Vietnam organizers have revoked the title of Nguyen Quynh Anh. Celebrity chef Martin Yan will headline cooking shows at Dong Thap's first Pangasius Festival. Hanoi is piloting electric tricycles for garbage collection. And there's more in your morning news round-up. 
 Miss Universe Vietnam 2026 Quynh Anh has been stripped of her crown. Photo: Kieng Can Studio
 | LIFESTYLE
 -- Miss Universe Vietnam organizers announced on Wednesday evening that they have revoked the title of Nguyen Quynh Anh, effective November 18. The organizers said that after an earlier violation, she was suspended from performing for six months, but she then attended a community event without informing or reaching agreement with Five6 Entertainment JSC, the company running the pageant. She also appeared at an announcement by another management company about an exclusive contract that had not been cleared with the organizers. On October 13, Quynh Anh had apologized over leaked screenshots of private chat messages in which she and other contestants criticized fellow participants.
 | TRAVEL
 -- International chef Martin Yan, known as Yan Can Cook, will hold three days of cooking demonstrations at the first Pangasius Festival in Dong Thap Province, said Tran Thi Be Bay, deputy director of the provincial Department of Agriculture and Environment, at a press briefing on Wednesday. The festival will run from December 3 to 6 in Hong Ngu and An Binh wards under the theme "From the Mekong to the World's Table." 
 Pangasius fish processing at GODACO Joint Stock Company in Dong Thap Province. Photo: Mau Truong / Tuoi Tre
 | ECONOMY
 -- Ho Chi Minh City will work with northern and north-central provinces to bring OCOP products, farm produce and local specialties into its distribution chain, wholesale markets, supermarkets and e-commerce platforms. The municipal People's Committee issued Plan 646 to implement a 2026-2030 cooperation agreement, under which the city will link businesses and cooperatives with partner localities in processing, distribution and sales. 
 -- Vinh Long Province has advised aquaculture farmers in areas with unsuitable conditions to temporarily stop stocking shrimp and fish through the end of 2026. The provincial Sub-Department of Fisheries, Fisheries Surveillance and Marine Islands said on Wednesday that, according to forecasts from the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, a very strong El Nino has emerged, with a 98 percent probability, and is likely to last until early summer 2027. Drought and widespread saltwater intrusion are expected in the Mekong Delta from November 2026 to around May 2027. 
 | ENVIRONMENT
 -- Hanoi's Urban Environment Company (Urenco) is piloting electric three-wheeled vehicles for garbage collection in Hoan Kiem Ward, with plans to expand the model in 2027 and 2028. Tran Thi Minh Hien, deputy head of the company's Technology Department, said at the 2026 Workers for the Environment Forum on Wednesday afternoon that 51 vehicles and 51 workers are collecting about 52 metric tons of waste a day in 21 of the ward's 28 residential groups. The model has eliminated 35 unsanitary collection points, removed 70 bins from streets, shortened collection routes by about 14 kilometers and cut an estimated 0.46 metric tons of CO2 equivalent a day. 
 Urenco is piloting electric garbage collection vehicles in Hoan Kiem Ward. Photo: Urenco
 | SOCIETY
 -- Border guards in Tay Ninh Province have broken up a drug trafficking ring that smuggled narcotics from Cambodia into Vietnam, the provincial Border Guard Command said on Wednesday. At 12:45 pm on November 11, border guards, working with an anti-drug task force and provincial police, caught Nguyen Van Quan, 30, and Tong Linh Chi, 26, both from Thoi Hoa Ward in Ho Chi Minh City, driving a car carrying 10 kilograms of crystal meth and two bricks of heroin on a road in Tuyen Binh Commune. A search of their home in Ho Chi Minh City turned up another 2 kilograms of crystal meth, bringing the total to more than 13 kilograms. Authorities also seized over VND100 million (about $4,100), the car and several mobile phones, and have opened a criminal case and expanded the investigation.
